title: Design system can be listed in the right column's + menu by the launch-design-system switch (off by default), only while the Design system feature is on
steps: S1: Run node --test packages/core/tracy-core/test/ui-switches.test.mjs and read the case 'Design system: a + menu entry of its own'.
expect: S1: launch-design-system is in group right-launcher, defaultOn false, tabs [tracy:design-system]; LAUNCHER_TABS lists tracy:design-system right after tracy:design-inspiration; isListed is false by default and true once /api/ui hides nothing.

S2: the plugin registers tracy:design-system without hidden; available() is true with toolbar-design-system on and false with it hidden; the side card's refreshAvailable is called once the switches land; opened with no site the tab says 'Open a site to choose its design system.'
fence: The tab policy (isListed) from the catalogue plus the descriptor's available predicate decide the + menu entry; no hard-coded list
